description: Uploading detected secret material to an unknown external host is denied.
laneYaml:
id: rt-secret-egress
version: 1
priority: 2000
mode: enforce
purpose: Permit local reading but deny secret egress.
appliesTo: { surfaces: [claude-code], agents: ['rt-secret-egress'] }
failMode: { default: closed, READ: open }
rules:
  deny:
    - id: secret-egress
      risk: [secret-egress]
  allow:
    - id: local-read
      category: [READ]
  judge: []
  approve: []
defaultVerdict: allow
approval: { channels: [dashboard], timeoutSec: 1 }
judge: { escalateBelow: 0.7, dataPolicy: redacted }
